goal: Verify that a user can create a new account as the Site Host, save a new memo, and successfully open the settings menu from the sidebar.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
In the main dashboard, type 'Remember to review the project timeline tomorrow morning.' into the text area labeled 'Any thoughts...' and click the 'Save' button.
Locate the settings icon (gear symbol) in the left sidebar and click it to open the settings menu.
success_criteria: The user is successfully logged in and redirected to the main dashboard after signing up.
The new memo containing the text 'Remember to review the project timeline tomorrow morning.' is visible in the feed.
The settings menu overlay appears, displaying options such as 'Shown time' and 'Order'.
No error messages are displayed during the account creation or memo saving process.
